name: Alt Mölln (Germany)
description: Green field above a narrow blue base separated by a white wavy stripe, charged with the figures of the municipal arms of Alt Mölln: a yellow windmill between a barrel and a sack.
history: The flag is blazoned as the figures of the municipal arms in flag tinctures on a cloth divided horizontally by a wavy white stripe into a broad green and a narrow blue stripe.

features.role: wavy white stripe above the blue base
barrel and sack beside the windmill
